steps: Blend cream cheese, softened butter, and minced garlic until smooth.
Season with a pinch of salt and sugar to balance the richness.
Slice plain buns into wedges or thick slices.
Pipe or spoon the garlic cheese mixture generously over the bread.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat with a little butter.
Toast the topped buns until golden and the cheese is melted.

swaps.why: Shop lacks an oven; a pan provides similar browning and melt.

swaps.use: Plain sliced bread or cheap buns
swaps.why: Easier to prep and fits the budget price band better.

hooks: Stop scrolling if you love garlic and cheese.
Your favorite Korean snack, made local and cheap.
Creamy, garlicky, and ready in minutes.
plan.caption: Ah Seng Drinks Stall is adding a savory twist to your drink run. Try our new Korean-style cream cheese garlic bread. We blend fresh garlic, butter, and cream cheese into a rich spread, then toast it on our stovetop until golden. Perfect for dipping in your Kopi or Teh Tarik. Come grab a bite before it’s gone! #SingaporeFood #AhSengDrinks
plan.offer: Buy any drink, get a garlic bread wedge for $1 extra.
